options.name: capacity_tier
options.description: The volume capacity tier for tiering cold data to object storage. The default values for each cloud provider are as follows, Amazon 'S3', Azure 'Blob', GCP 'cloudStorage'. If NONE, the capacity tier will not be set on volume creation.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector.

options.name: destination_aggregate_name
options.description: The aggregate in which the volume will be created. If not provided, Cloud Manager chooses the best aggregate for you.

options.name: destination_svm_name
options.description: The name of the destination SVM. The default SVM name is used, if a name is not provided.

options.name: destination_volume_name
options.description: The name of the destination volume to be created for snapmirror relationship.

options.name: destination_working_environment_id
options.description: The public ID of the working environment of the destination volume.

options.name: destination_working_environment_name
options.description: The working environment name of the destination volume.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: max_transfer_rate
options.description: Maximum transfer rate limit KB/s. Use 0 for no limit, otherwise use number between 1024 and 2,147,482,624.

options.name: policy
options.description: The SnapMirror policy name.

options.name: provider_volume_type
options.description: The underlying cloud provider volume type. For AWS ['gp3', 'gp2', 'io1', 'st1', 'sc1']. For Azure ['Premium_LRS','Standard_LRS','StandardSSD_LRS']. For GCP ['pd-balanced','pd-ssd','pd-standard'].

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: schedule
options.description: The name of the Schedule.

options.name: source_svm_name
options.description: The name of the source SVM. The default SVM name is used, if a name is not provided.

options.name: source_volume_name
options.description: The name of the source volume.

options.name: source_working_environment_id
options.description: The public ID of the working environment of the source volume.

options.name: source_working_environment_name
options.description: The working environment name of the source volume.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified snapmirror relationship should exist or not.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: The NetApp account ID that the Connector will be associated with. To be used only when using FSx.
